question: How is the svādhiṣṭhāna center visually characterized in this instruction?
premises: The svādhiṣṭhāna center is the object described.
It is compared to pure crystal.
The description is given as a visualization.
inference: The svādhiṣṭhāna center is to be visualized as resembling pure crystal.
plain_english: O Great Goddess, visualize the svādhiṣṭhāna as resembling pure crystal.
